title: Proactive Agentic Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2610.13485v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic orchestration delegates tasks to sub-agents with independent contexts, providing a key path to extending the effective execution horizon of large language model agents. However, existing orchestration methods face two limitations: in execution, current methods fix sub-agents' goals and harnesses at creation time, limiting their adaptability to dynamic real-world environments; in optimization, sparse and delayed feedback constrains effective learning of the orchestration policy. To address these limitations, we introduce POrchestra, an on-the-fly proactive agentic orchestration framework. It allows sub-agents to proactively communicate with the orchestrator at any logical point to request harness adjustments while maintaining continuity of local execution. This mechanism not only enables sub-agents to adapt seamlessly to dynamic environments but also naturally inspires On-Policy Orchestration Distillation (OPOD) based on hindsight

translated_abstract: 智能体编排将任务委托给具有独立上下文的子智能体，为扩展大语言模型智能体的有效执行时程提供了一条关键路径。然而，现有的编排方法面临两个局限：在执行方面，当前方法在创建时就固定了子智能体的目标和工具框架，限制了其对动态真实环境的适应性；在优化方面，稀疏且延迟的反馈制约了编排策略的有效学习。为解决这些局限，我们提出了POrchestra，一个即时主动式智能体编排框架。该框架允许子智能体在任何逻辑节点上主动与编排器通信以请求调整其工具框架，同时保持局部执行的连续性。这一机制不仅使子智能体能够无缝适应动态环境，还自然地启发了基于事后洞察的在策略编排蒸馏方法。
tldr: 本文提出主动式智能体编排框架POrchestra，允许子智能体在执行过程中随时主动请求编排器调整其目标和工具框架，从而无缝适应动态环境，并据此提出了基于事后洞察的在策略编排蒸馏方法来优化编排策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes POrchestra, a proactive agentic orchestration framework that allows sub-agents to proactively request harness adjustments from the orchestrator at any logical point during execution, enabling seamless adaptation to dynamic environments and inspiring hindsight-based On-Policy Orchestration Distillation for optimizing the orchestration policy.
